root_cause.text: The Airoha driver freed `metadata_dst` objects directly with `metadata_dst_free()`/`kfree()` while RX skbs could still hold a non-refcounted `dst` pointer set by `skb_dst_set_noref()`, violating the required RCU lifetime protection and enabling a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch notes that `skb_dst_set_noref()` “requires RCU read-side protection and the dst must remain valid until all RCU readers complete,” but `airoha_metadata_dst_free()` previously called `metadata_dst_free()` which “frees the metadata_dst with kfree() immediately, bypassing the RCU grace period”; the fix changes this to `dst_release(&port->dsa_meta[i]->dst)` so freeing goes through the refcount/RCU path via `call_rcu_hurry()`.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch notes that `skb_dst_set_noref()` “requires RCU read-side protection and the dst must remain valid until all RCU readers complete,” but `airoha_metadata_dst_free()` previously called `metadata_dst_free()` which “frees the metadata_dst with kfree() immediately, bypassing the RCU grace period”; the fix changes this to `dst_release(&port->dsa_meta[i]->dst)` so freeing goes through the refcount/RCU path via `call_rcu_hurry()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Use the proper dst release path when freeing metadata destination objects.
intent_record.what: Inside `airoha_metadata_dst_free(struct airoha_gdm_port *port)`, the code that freed each non-NULL `port->dsa_meta[i]` entry changed from calling `metadata_dst_free(port->dsa_meta[i])` to calling `dst_release(&port->dsa_meta[i]->dst)`.
intent_record.how: This changes the lifetime management of the metadata destination object from a direct metadata-specific free routine to the generic destination release path, which will decrement the dst object's reference count and free it only when appropriate. It avoids bypassing the normal dst ownership rules and helps prevent incorrect teardown of the embedded `dst` structure.

grouping_result.intent: Use the proper dst release path when freeing metadata destination objects.

relevance_review.reason: The change matches the root cause: it switches freeing of metadata_dst objects to the proper dst release path, addressing the unsafe direct free of dst pointers that could be held by RX skbs and cause a use-after-free.

candidates.rationale: This directly frees a metadata_dst object with metadata_dst_free() while RX skbs may still reference it via a non-refcounted dst pointer set with skb_dst_set_noref(), which can leave a dangling pointer and cause a use-after-free.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement directly frees a metadata_dst object. Per the root cause, RX skbs may still hold a non-refcounted dst pointer set via skb_dst_set_noref(), so freeing the object here can leave a dangling dst pointer and trigger a use-after-free.

In RX it uses a preallocated metadata object and attaches it with `skb_dst_set_noref(skb, &port->dsa_meta[sptag]->dst);`, and on teardown it frees those objects via `airoha_metadata_dst_free(port)`. The vulnerable construct described in the root cause—directly freeing a `metadata_dst` while RX skbs still hold a non-refcounted dst pointer—is not present in this snippet. Instead, this commit clearly adds the metadata-dst allocation/free lifecycle and the `skb_dst_set_noref()` usage, which is the relevant fix mechanism.
